steps.en: Install dependencies and start the local dashboard on Node 22
steps.zh: 用 Node 22 安装依赖并启动本地看板

steps.en: Opens a fictional company in a separate demo store
steps.zh: 从独立演示存储打开虚构公司

steps.en: Turn Filming mode off in Settings to start your real business
steps.zh: 在设置关闭演示模式，切换到真实业务

steps.en: Switches to the initially blank real data directory
steps.zh: 切换到初始为空的真实数据目录

steps.en: Provide your Stripe account's secret key
steps.zh: 提供你自己的 Stripe 账户密钥

steps.en: Reads balances and recent charges into the finance view
steps.zh: 读取余额与近期交易，汇入财务界面

value.en: Your actual payment data appears beside the business dashboard instead of fictional sample revenue
value.zh: 经营看板显示真实收款，不再把虚构收入当作业务状态
